title: Instant Pot Butternut Squash Soup

Main: 2 lbs butternut squash, halved with seeds removed or cubed with skin and seeds removed
2 cups chicken broth (or 2 tsp Chicken Better Than Bouillon + 2 cups water)
2 cups garlic broth (or 4 cups chicken or vegetable broth)
Spices & Seasonings: 1 tsp black pepper, plus extra for garnish
1 tsp rubbed sage, plus extra for garnish
1 tsp dried thyme, plus extra for garnish
For Serving: 1/3 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus extra for garnish

steps: If using a whole squash, halve it lengthwise and scoop out seeds with an ice cream scooper; reserve seeds for toasting if desired.
Place squash on the trivet in the Instant Pot with 1 cup water. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes, then quick-release. Remove and let cool.
Discard cooking water, select Sauté (More/High), add oil and butter, then cook shallots 3 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Pour in broths, seasoned salt, black pepper, white pepper, nutmeg, sage, and thyme. Secure lid and pressure cook High for 3 minutes, then quick-release.
Scoop the cooked squash meat into a bowl, discarding skin and any tough bits.
Return squash to the pot and purée with an immersion blender until smooth and thickened.
Stir in Worcestershire sauce, Parmesan, heavy cream, and sugar until combined.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with extra sage, thyme, pepper, cream, or toasted squash seeds.
